citations.narrative:
The facility did not maintain a complete medical record for all dogs. The facility states the last few weeks they have been
treating an adult female Rottweiler (#956000015267523) with topical spray (Purishield) and a fly spray to treat wounds on
the ears and nose. However, the facility did not record any of the treatments given in the medical record.
Failure to maintain adequate medical records may interfere with the ability of APHIS officials to determine if the animals
are receiving adequate veterinary care. Complete medical records must be maintained and include the names of all
vaccines and treatments administered and the dates of administration. Correct by documenting all treatments given and
ensure that medical records are complete and contain the required information. Correct by 21-JULY-2026.

The facility was unable to provide documentation for an examination performed by the Attending Veterinarian for an adult
female Rottweiler (#956000015267523). The facility stated the Attending Veterinarian examined the animal a few weeks
ago for wounds on the ears and nose. However, the facility could not provide documentation of this examination.
Failure to document results of examinations performed may interfere with the ability of APHIS officials to determine if the
animals are receiving adequate veterinary care. Medical records must be maintained and include the dates and
findings/results of all screening, routine, or other required or recommended test or examination. Correct by documenting
the results of all examinations and ensure that medical records are complete and contain the required information. Correct
by 21-JULY-2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the Licensee.
